messages.「暁の火」を30まで貯めて強化S3「明け方」を撃ち、全味方に「夜明け迎え」3を配: A Burn and Tremor Identity that builds 30 Light of Daybreak for enhanced S3 Crack of Dawn, granting 3 Dawnherald to all allies. Dawnherald accelerates Light of Daybreak generation, potentially enabling Crack of Dawn every 3–4 turns and maintaining the buff. Deploying all 3 Dawn Office members completes the passive coordination.
messages.暁の火(最大30・1ターンにつき最大20): 基本攻撃スキルの的中時に(1+対象: **Light of Daybreak (max 30, up to 20 per turn)**: He gains (1 + target's Burn Potency ÷ 3) on each basic attack skill hit, up to 3. The Defense skills Guardian and Heat Haze grant 5 each on use (Heat Haze once per turn). Through the combat passive Morgenfeuer [Stigma Workshop] (2 Wrath and 2 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), basic attack skill hits grant +2 while he has Dawnherald. At 10 or more, +1 Burn Potency inflicted; at 20 or more, +1 Burn Count inflicted. At Turn Start, he gains 1 Burn per 5 and +1 Burn Count per 10.
messages.明け方: 暁の火が30なら、S3「夜明けを裂く剣」か守備「守護者」が使用前に「明: **Crack of Dawn**: At 30 Light of Daybreak, S3 Dawnsplitter or the Defense skill Guardian turns into Crack of Dawn before use (once per turn). All Coins Unbreakable, 3 Attack Weight, and +75% damage per target fewer than its Attack Weight (+50% at lower Uptie). After the attack, he gives 3 Dawnherald to all allies next turn, spends up to 15 of his own Burn Potency, and heals (15 + amount spent)% of his max HP. All Light of Daybreak is spent.
messages.夜明け迎え(最大3・ターン終了時に1減少): 火傷威力・火傷回数か特殊火傷を付与: **Dawnherald (max 3, decreases by 1 at Turn End)**: +10% damage for skills that inflict Burn Potency, Burn Count, or special Burn (+15% for Wrath). +1 Clash Power for such basic skills (+1 Base Power instead for Dawn Office members). The regular S3 also gives 1 to all allies next turn after the attack (1 more at 20 or more Light of Daybreak).
messages.暁の火20以上の強化: S1「黎明の閃光」に破壊不能コインが1つ追加される(低い: **Bonuses at 20+ Light of Daybreak**: S1 Flash of Sunup gains 1 extra Unbreakable Coin (requires 30 or more at lower Uptie). S2 Sunset Blade also gains an extra Unbreakable Coin that triggers Tremor Burst on hit. S3 gains +1 Final Power and all-Unbreakable Coins.
messages.自傷への備え: 常時発動の「夜明け頃のフィクサー」により、火傷ダメージでは混乱せ: **Preparing for self-damage**: Through the always-active The Fixer at the Crack of Dawn, Burn damage does not stagger him and cannot reduce his HP below 1. Damage taken from Burn is −50% (−75% below 50% HP). Guardian reduces his own Burn Count by 2 on Clash Win and by 5 at the end of the skill (once per turn each).
messages.夜明事務所の連携: 常時発動の「夜明事務所」は、初登場時に夜明事務所所属が2名以: **Dawn Office coordination**: The always-active Dawn Office gives everyone Dawn Office equal to the number of members if 2 or more Dawn Office members are present on first appearing (+1 Offense Level per point; at 3, restores 5 SP at Turn Start). Through Morgenfeuer, when Dawn Office allies stagger an enemy with basic skills (not enemies already staggered before the attack began), or after Dawn Office Fixer Faust's Eject, Eject - High Noon, or Dismemberment at High Noon, or Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair's Stigmatize or Blazing Strike, he follows up with Flash of Sunup (once per turn per Identity).
messages.敵に火傷がない序盤は、守備の「守護者」と「陽炎」で暁の火を稼ぐ。火傷が付いたらS: Early on, when enemies have no Burn, earn Light of Daybreak with the Defense skills Guardian and Heat Haze. Once Burn is applied, also earn it from S1 and S2 hits, gaining the bonuses at 20 or more. He can gain at most 20 per turn, so reaching 30 takes until turn 2 at the earliest. At 30, fire Crack of Dawn from S3 or Guardian, rebuild Light of Daybreak with the +2 bonus while Dawnherald lasts, and chain into Crack of Dawn again. However, Dawnherald decreases every turn, so there will be turns when it lapses midway. After Crack of Dawn, Light of Daybreak starts from 0, so he tends to run out of steam. Conversely, hoarding too much increases his self-inflicted Burn, so fire it once it reaches 30. Any skill that inflicts Burn benefits from Dawnherald.
